QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Mining for Truth
QuestInfo.0: Find Eremos to learn where the next Ryuul training location is.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Wings are infamous in Maple World. It is important to maintain the balance of the universe by punishing the Black Wings for their evil deeds. Eremos says you'll find them in Verne Mine.
QuestInfo.2: It seems Surana disagrees with Eremos's decision to punish the Black Wings. Will punishing villains in the name of justice make a champion equally reprehensible?
